target_concepts.description: Divisibility lattice and greatest common divisor linear combination invariant.
target_concepts.name: Divisibility and Greatest Common Divisor
target_concepts.quantifier_contract: FORALL (a, b in Z, not both 0) EXISTS! (d = gcd(a,b) in Z+)

target_concepts.description: Division algorithm finite remainder descent chain computing gcd(a,b).
target_concepts.name: The Euclidean Division and Remainder Algorithm
target_concepts.quantifier_contract: FORALL (a in Z, b in Z+) EXISTS (q_k, r_k finite descent trace ending in 0)

target_concepts.description: Extended Euclidean matrix backward substitution computing Bézout certificates.
target_concepts.name: Bézout's Identity and Extended Euclidean Multipliers
target_concepts.quantifier_contract: FORALL (a, b in Z) EXISTS (x, y in Z : a*x + b*y = gcd(a,b))

target_concepts.description: Unique prime factorization multi-set representation.
target_concepts.name: Fundamental Theorem of Arithmetic and Prime Factorization
target_concepts.quantifier_contract: FORALL (n >= 2) EXISTS! (p_1^{e_1} ... p_k^{e_k} canonical prime power product)

target_concepts.description: Modular residue classes and cyclic quotient ring Z/mZ operations.
target_concepts.name: Modular Congruences and Residue Ring Arithmetic
target_concepts.quantifier_contract: FORALL (m in Z+, a, b in Z : a == b mod m <=> m | (a-b))

target_concepts.description: Simultaneous residue reconstruction isomorphism Z_mn = Z_m x Z_n.
target_concepts.name: Chinese Remainder Theorem for Coprime Moduli
target_concepts.quantifier_contract: FORALL (m, n coprime, a, b in Z) EXISTS! (x in Z_{mn} : x == a mod m and x == b mod n)

target_concepts.description: Coprime residue group order phi(n) and modular power cycle closure.
target_concepts.name: Euler's Totient Function and Coprime Exponentiation Theorem
target_concepts.quantifier_contract: FORALL (n in Z+, a in Z with gcd(a,n)=1 : a^{phi(n)} == 1 mod n)

target_concepts.description: Prime field multiplicative order p-1 modular inversion.
target_concepts.name: Fermat's Little Theorem for Prime Moduli
target_concepts.quantifier_contract: FORALL (p prime, a in Z with p !| a : a^{p-1} == 1 mod p)

target_concepts.description: Cayley regular representation and Latin square table consistency.
hypotheses: Set G closed under binary op
target_concepts.name: Group Axioms and Permutation Regular Representations
target_concepts.quantifier_contract: FORALL (a, b, c in G : (ab)c = a(bc), exists e, exists a^{-1})

target_concepts.description: Subgroup poset lattice and closure under inverses.
target_concepts.name: Subgroups, Subgroup Criterion, and Lattices
target_concepts.quantifier_contract: FORALL (non-empty H subset G : (a, b in H => ab^{-1} in H) <=> H <= G)

target_concepts.description: Equipotent disjoint coset fiber partition of group manifold.
target_concepts.name: Left and Right Coset Partitions
target_concepts.quantifier_contract: FORALL (H <= G, g in G : |gH| = |H| and cosets form partition of G)

target_concepts.description: Index formula and order divisibility across finite groups.
target_concepts.name: Lagrange's Order Divisibility Theorem
target_concepts.quantifier_contract: FORALL (finite G, H <= G : |H| divides |G| and |G| = [G:H] * |H|)

target_concepts.description: Cyclic permutation digraph and divisor subgroup lattice.
target_concepts.name: Cyclic Groups, Generators, and Subgroup Lattices
target_concepts.quantifier_contract: FORALL (G = <a> cyclic of order n : for every d | n exists unique subgroup of order d)

target_concepts.description: Homomorphic commutative diagram tensor evaluation.
target_concepts.name: Group Homomorphisms and Structure Preservation
target_concepts.quantifier_contract: FORALL (f: G -> H : f(xy) = f(x)f(y) for all x, y in G)

target_concepts.description: Kernel subspace projection and inverse image fiber partition.
target_concepts.name: Kernels, Images, and Fiber Decompositions
target_concepts.quantifier_contract: FORALL (f: G -> H : ker f <= G, im f <= H, fibers f^{-1}(h) = g * ker f)

target_concepts.description: Self-conjugate normal subgroup characterization and left/right coset equality.
target_concepts.name: Normal Subgroups and Conjugation Invariance
target_concepts.quantifier_contract: FORALL (N <= G : (forall g in G : gNg^{-1} = N) <=> N <| G)

target_concepts.description: Quotient group Cayley graph and coset multiplication table.
target_concepts.name: Factor Groups and Coset Multiplication Operations
target_concepts.quantifier_contract: FORALL (N <| G : (aN)(bN) = (ab)N is well-defined group on G/N)

target_concepts.description: Canonical bijective isomorphism between quotient cosets and image elements.
target_concepts.name: First Isomorphism Theorem for Groups
target_concepts.quantifier_contract: FORALL (f: G -> H : ker f <| G and G / ker f ~= im f)

target_concepts.description: Permutation cycle decomposition and alternating group index 2 parity kernel.
target_concepts.name: Symmetric and Alternating Groups, Cycle Parity
target_concepts.quantifier_contract: FORALL (n >= 2 : sgn: S_n -> {+1, -1} is homom, ker(sgn) = A_n with |A_n| = n!/2)

target_concepts.description: Action permutation matrix representation and orbit-stabilizer coset bijection.
hypotheses: G finite group acting on finite set X
target_concepts.name: Group Actions, Orbits, and Orbit-Stabilizer Theorem
target_concepts.quantifier_contract: FORALL (G acting on X, x in X : |G| = |Orb(x)| * |Stab(x)|)

target_concepts.description: Bilinear ring operation tensors and distributive validation.
hypotheses: Set R with two binary operations +, *
target_concepts.name: Ring Axioms and Matrix Ring Structures
target_concepts.quantifier_contract: FORALL (a, b, c in R : (R,+) abelian, * assoc, a(b+c)=ab+ac, (a+b)c=ac+bc)

target_concepts.description: Multiplicative group of units R^x and zero-divisor graph.
target_concepts.name: Units, Invertible Elements, and Zero Divisors
target_concepts.quantifier_contract: FORALL (r in R with 1 : r in R^x <=> exists r^{-1}; r zero-divisor <=> exists s!=0: rs=0)

target_concepts.description: Zero-divisor-free ring cancellation algebraic and cell verification.
target_concepts.name: Integral Domains and Cancellation Properties
target_concepts.quantifier_contract: FORALL (comm ring R with 1!=0 : (forall a, b: ab=0 => a=0 or b=0) <=> R is domain)

target_concepts.description: Absorption matrix closure and principal ideal generator lattice.
hypotheses: I additive subgroup with multiplicative absorption
target_concepts.name: Ideals, Ideal Absorption, and Principal Ideals
target_concepts.quantifier_contract: FORALL (I subset R : (I <= (R,+) and forall r in R, a in I: ra in I) <=> I is ideal)

target_concepts.description: Quotient ring addition and multiplication coset cell complex.
target_concepts.name: Quotient Rings and Residue Arithmetic
target_concepts.quantifier_contract: FORALL (ideal I of R : (r+I)(s+I) = rs+I is well-defined on R/I)

target_concepts.description: Ring homomorphism kernel ideal absorption and quotient isomorphism.
target_concepts.name: Ring Homomorphisms, Kernels, and First Isomorphism Theorem
target_concepts.quantifier_contract: FORALL (phi: R -> S : ker phi is ideal of R and R / ker phi ~= im phi)

target_concepts.description: Prime ideal factor characterization and domain quotient verification.
target_concepts.name: Prime Ideals and Integral Domain Quotient Characterization
target_concepts.quantifier_contract: FORALL (ideal P of comm R : (ab in P => a in P or b in P) <=> R/P is integral domain)

target_concepts.description: Maximal ideal unit-generation and field inversion quotient verification.
target_concepts.name: Maximal Ideals and Field Quotient Characterization
target_concepts.quantifier_contract: FORALL (ideal M of comm R : M maximal <=> R/M is a field)

target_concepts.description: Polynomial coefficient algebra matrix and convolution multiplication.
target_concepts.name: Polynomial Rings R[x] and Degree Valuations
target_concepts.quantifier_contract: FORALL (f, g in R[x] over domain R : deg(f*g) = deg(f) + deg(g))

target_concepts.description: Irreducible polynomial Euclidean inversion matrix constructing field F[x]/(p(x)).
target_concepts.name: Irreducible Polynomials and Quotient Extension Fields
target_concepts.quantifier_contract: FORALL (p(x) in F[x] : p(x) irreducible <=> F[x]/(p(x)) is a field)

target_concepts.description: Vector space basis expansion and degree product tower law.
hypotheses: Tower of field extensions F <= K <= E
target_concepts.name: Field Extensions, Algebraic Elements, and Tower Law
target_concepts.quantifier_contract: FORALL (F <= K <= E fields : [E : F] = [E : K] * [K : F])

target_concepts.description: Galois field GF(p^n) arithmetic, Frobenius linear map, and cyclic unit generator.
target_concepts.name: Finite Fields (Galois Fields) and Frobenius Automorphisms
target_concepts.quantifier_contract: FORALL (prime p, n >= 1 : exists! GF(p^n) of order p^n; Frob(x)=x^p is automorphism)
